source_of_truth: Database app_roadmap_execution_items after the Build 238 migration; this file is a read-only current-cycle fallback.

items.title: Apply Build 238 inventory transaction migration in staging
items.action_path: Supabase SQL Editor → sql/2026-07-30_build238_inventory_transactions_merge_seo_preflight.sql

items.title: Preview and execute one harmless two-row inventory merge
items.action_path: /admin-inventory-manager.html → select two known duplicate test rows → Review two-row merge

items.title: Preview and execute one transactional bulk inventory update
items.action_path: /admin-inventory-manager.html → select test rows → enter field/value/reason → Preview batch → Apply transaction

items.title: Verify Build 238 SEO title and description changes in preview
items.action_path: Preview homepage, services, pricing, booking, gallery, fleet, maintenance and town pages; inspect title, description, canonical and H1.

items.title: Complete Block Calendar full-day AM PM production-like test
items.action_path: /admin-blocks.html → create/remove future full-day, AM-only and PM-only blocks → verify /book.html availability

items.title: Complete end-to-end booking and admin record verification
items.action_path: /book.html → complete test booking → verify /admin-booking.html, customer record, calendar and staff views

items.title: Complete and refund a small live Stripe transaction
items.action_path: /admin-payments.html and Stripe Dashboard → charge a small approved amount → verify webhook/receipt → refund → reconcile

items.title: Verify all required notification types in external inboxes
items.action_path: /admin-test-centre.html → test booking, payment, staff and consent messages in external inboxes and on mobile

items.title: Audit Cloudflare production variables bindings and branches
items.action_path: Cloudflare Dashboard → Workers & Pages → Rosie Dazzlers → Settings → Variables, Bindings, Custom domains and Builds

items.title: Perform Supabase staging backup and restore rehearsal
items.action_path: Supabase Dashboard → Database → Backups → restore a safe staging copy or selected records → verify rows and permissions

items.title: Review and publish customer policy and consent wording
items.action_path: /admin-site-settings.html and footer policy pages → review privacy, terms, cancellation, refund, media consent and cookies

items.title: Complete iPhone-size and Android-size real-device checks
items.action_path: Test public booking/payment and admin calendar/inventory/uploads on one iPhone-size and one Android-size real device

items.title: Complete accessibility keyboard focus contrast and errors
items.action_path: /admin-test-centre.html plus critical public/admin routes → keyboard-only, visible focus, labels, contrast, errors and reduced motion

items.title: Submit sitemap and validate canonical and structured data
items.action_path: Google Search Console and Rich Results Test → submit sitemap → inspect canonicals, indexing and LocalBusiness structured data

items.title: Verify Google Business Profile categories service area and proof
items.action_path: Google Business Profile → Edit profile → verify primary/secondary categories, services, service area, hours, phone and approved photos

items.title: Finish suspicious inventory name category and cost cleanup
items.action_path: /admin-inventory-manager.html → filter suspicious/missing data → correct names, category, cost, vendor and type → update row

items.title: Complete featured and seven-image product media metadata
items.action_path: /admin-inventory-manager.html and /admin-catalog.html → set featured image, up to seven gallery images, order, alt text and captions

items.title: Replace high-value public visual placeholders with local proof
items.action_path: /admin-media-health.html plus IMAGES.md → replace hero, service, local proof and booking placeholders with approved Rosie-owned media

items.title: Run invite-only soft launch with daily incident review
items.action_path: /admin-launch-readiness.html and /admin-today.html → invite limited users → inspect each booking/payment/message/image/stock movement daily

items.title: Modernize release guards before archiving redundant Markdown
items.action_path: scripts/release_check.py and DOC_INDEX.md → replace obsolete content markers with current capability checks → archive only after full pass
